tools.name: get_life_quote_requirements
tools.description: Get required inputs for anonymous US life insurance and long-term-care quotes across enabled non-annuity product types, including product-specific inputs, solves, health labels, and rider filters. No name, email, phone, SSN, account, or existing application is needed.

tools.name: quote_term_life
tools.description: Get term-life quotes using explicit user-provided rating inputs. Results include consumer product details, benefit comparisons, and quote-based application guidance. Each result includes an opaque quote_id valid for 30 minutes. After the user selects a quote and requests an application, call create_life_eapp to get their application link. Never invent missing inputs or an underwriting class.

gender.description: Carrier rating input, supplied by the user

health.description: User-supplied assumed health value. Read product-specific labels from get_life_quote_requirements; never infer eligibility.

frequency.description: Uses per year: 2 less than monthly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

mode.description: Payments per year: annual, semiannual, quarterly, monthly

tools.name: quote_final_expense
tools.description: Get final-expense life insurance quotes, including small burial/funeral coverage. Supports the platform coverage range of $5,000 to $100,000,000, subject to carrier/product limits. No term duration. Uses monthly or annual payments and an explicit assumed health value. Each returned quote_id can be used with create_life_eapp after user selection.

gender.description: Carrier rating input, supplied by the user

health.description: Explicit assumed final-expense health value. Use the health_classes in get_life_quote_requirements; never infer eligibility.

frequency.description: Uses per year: 2 less than monthly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

mode.description: Payments per year: 1 annually or 12 monthly

guaranteed_issue.description: Optional guaranteed-issue-only filter; defaults to false

tools.name: quote_life_insurance
tools.description: Quote all supported non-annuity products: term, non-med term, return-of-premium term, final expense (fex), UL, accumulation IUL (iul), protection IUL (piul), VUL where enabled/licensed, whole life, linked benefits, traditional LTC, and accidental death. Supports LTC/chronic illness riders on life products. Call get_life_quote_requirements first for enabled products and each product's schema/health labels. Use explicit user inputs. Returns consumer product details, comparison benefits, exam/application guidance, illustration values when available, and signed quote_id selections for create_life_eapp. Annuities are excluded.

health.description: User-supplied assumed health value. Get product-specific labels from get_life_quote_requirements. Never infer underwriting eligibility.

mode.description: Payments per year: annual, semiannual, quarterly, monthly

tools.name: create_life_eapp
tools.description: Create an eApp from a quote_id returned by any public quote tool and return its private apply_link. Call only after the user selects that quote and explicitly asks to start an application. Retries for the same quote reuse the eApp. Give the user the private apply_link and explain that they must open it to continue in Quote & Apply, complete the remaining application steps, and sign where required. This MCP action does not complete or submit the application to a carrier or bind coverage.

quote_id.description: Opaque quote_id from a public life quote tool; raw cache IDs and existing eApp IDs are not accepted

user_confirmed.description: The user selected this quote and explicitly requested starting an application

tools.name: quote_life_eapp
tools.description: Get fresh non-annuity quotes for the eApp created through public MCP, using its saved rating inputs and optional scenario changes. Requires its private application_token. Does not change the application. Returned quote_id selections are bound to this application and its current revision.

application_token.description: Private application_token returned by create_life_eapp; an eApp ID, UUID, or completion URL is not accepted

health.description: User-supplied assumed health value. Get product-specific labels from get_life_quote_requirements. Never infer underwriting eligibility.

tools.name: update_life_eapp_quote
tools.description: Select a quote returned by quote_life_eapp for that same application. Requires its private application_token, application-bound quote_id, and explicit user confirmation. Applies the selected rating inputs and quote, retains quote history, and returns the completion link. Rejects stale selections and locked/submitted applications. Give the user the private apply_link and explain that they must open it to continue in Quote & Apply, complete the remaining application steps, and sign where required. This MCP action does not complete or submit the application to a carrier or bind coverage.

application_token.description: Private application_token returned by create_life_eapp; an eApp ID, UUID, or completion URL is not accepted

user_confirmed.description: The user explicitly requested these application changes

tools.name: update_life_eapp_insured
tools.description: Update the primary or joint insured's name, email, phone, or supported rating inputs for the eApp created through public MCP. Requires its private application_token and explicit user confirmation. Rating changes invalidate the selected quote and require fresh quotes before selection. SSNs, payment data, medical answers, agent/domain overrides, and signed/submitted application edits are not accepted. Give the user the private apply_link and explain that they must open it to continue in Quote & Apply, complete the remaining application steps, and sign where required. This MCP action does not complete or submit the application to a carrier or bind coverage.

application_token.description: Private application_token returned by create_life_eapp; an eApp ID, UUID, or completion URL is not accepted

user_confirmed.description: The user explicitly requested these application changes
